cwe_descriptions: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') — The product constructs all or part of an OS command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended OS command when it is sent to a downstream component.
CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor — The product exposes sensitive information to an actor that is not explicitly authorized to have access to that information.
